title: Vow and Songbook
author: Wendell Zhou
blurb: August Dravenmoor, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
